sourceNote: Set at the MPC meeting of 11 August 2026 and unchanged since. Still current as of the CBK Weekly Bulletin dated 18 September 2026, which reports KESONIA "remained stable at 8.75 percent" through the week ending 17 September and the Cash Reserve Ratio at 3.25 percent. Note precisely what that corroborates: the bulletin does not print the CBR itself, but an overnight interbank average sitting exactly on 8.75 is inconsistent with a policy rate that has moved. The next MPC is due early October.
